---level39 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl39_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		game.pauseLogic();
		sound.play("50-1")
		if dialog.show("Level39-1", faceJingya) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level39-2", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level39-3", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end

		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl39_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false
		game.resumeLogic();

		isSkip = false
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
